standards.title: Standards
standards.subtitle: Check and convert to archival (PDF/A) and print (PDF/X) standards.
standards.desc.pdfa-1b: Long-term archiving based on PDF 1.4. No transparency, layers or attachments.
standards.desc.pdfa-2b: Long-term archiving based on PDF 1.7. Transparency and layers are allowed.
standards.desc.pdfa-2u: Like PDF/A-2b, and every character maps to Unicode, so text stays searchable and copyable.
standards.desc.pdfa-3b: Like PDF/A-2b, and it may carry any attached file, such as an XML invoice.
standards.desc.pdfx-4: Print exchange: embedded fonts, an output intent and trim boxes.
standards.desc.preflight: A summary of fonts, pictures, colour, transparency, forms and scripts.
